_about: Monitored channels. Public channels only, read from their t.me/s web page — no Telegram account or subscription needed.
_reliability: Per-source probability that a town match here means a real threat. Combined across sources as 1 - PROD(1 - r). One reliable source = 90%, all of them = 100%. The two local channels stay silent alone (Типова 50%, ППО 80%) but confirm each other: ППО + Типова = 90%.
_requiresThreat: true = message must ALSO contain a danger keyword (config/threat-keywords.json). Only for channels that publish non-threat content.
_rejectNews: true = drop after-the-fact news about an attack that is over (config/news-keywords.json). For the local channels, which post both.
_localDistricts: true = also match city districts (Тяжилів, ГПЗ, Київська…, see each town's `districts`). Only for oblast-only channels: on a national feed «Київська» or «Центр» is somewhere else.
_vagueNeedsSecondSource: true = a post that only points toward the town («у бік Вінниці», «в районі Вінниці») counts as 0.5 here, so it goes loud only with a second channel. Direct wording («на Вінницю», «курсом на Вінницю») keeps the full reliability. Applies to stable and beta.
_beta: true = only the beta track (BETA_CHAT_IDS in .env) reads this channel. Stable subscribers, the watchdog and the stable shadow log never see it. Not scraped at all while BETA_CHAT_IDS is empty.
_webPreview: false = channel genuinely publishes no t.me/s page. A transient 302 is NOT this — it recovers on its own, is handled by backoff, and is logged as [scrape:302].
